totals:
-- One row per campaign, plus 'all' for the whole campaign group
WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM `stackadapt-reporting.stackadapt_hamptons.v_daily_all` WHERE campaign_group_id = '@@GROUP@@'
), c AS (
  SELECT * FROM `stackadapt-reporting.stackadapt_hamptons.v_conversion_trackers_daily`
  WHERE campaign_group_id = '@@GROUP@@'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id, email_dt, conversion_trackers ORDER BY loaded_at DESC) = 1
), t AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(campaign_id, 'all') AS campaign,
    FORMAT_DATE('%F', MIN(stat_date)) AS first_day, FORMAT_DATE('%F', MAX(stat_date)) AS last_day,
    SUM(impressions) AS impressions, SUM(clicks) AS clicks, SUM(media_cost) AS spend,
    SUM(video_completed) AS video_completed, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT channel_type, ', ') AS channels,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(average_time_seconds IS NOT NULL, average_time_seconds * clicks, 0)), SUM(IF(average_time_seconds IS NOT NULL, clicks, 0))) AS avg_time_on_site_sec
  FROM d GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((campaign_id), ())
), cv AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(campaign_id, 'all') AS campaign, SUM(conversions) AS conversions, SUM(click_conversions) AS click_conversions, SUM(impression_conversions) AS impression_conversions
  FROM c GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((campaign_id), ())
)
SELECT t.campaign, t.first_day, t.last_day, t.impressions, t.clicks, SAFE_DIVIDE(t.clicks, t.impressions) AS ctr,
  t.avg_time_on_site_sec, t.spend, SAFE_DIVIDE(t.spend, t.clicks) AS cpc,
  IFNULL(cv.conversions, 0) AS conversions, IFNULL(cv.click_conversions, 0) AS click_conversions, IFNULL(cv.impression_conversions, 0) AS impression_conversions,
  t.video_completed, SAFE_DIVIDE(t.video_completed, t.impressions) AS vcr, t.channels
FROM t LEFT JOIN cv USING (campaign)
ORDER BY campaign
daily:
SELECT COALESCE(campaign_id, 'all') AS campaign, FORMAT_DATE('%F', stat_date) AS day,
  SUM(impressions) AS impressions,
  SUM(clicks) AS clicks,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(clicks), SUM(impressions)) AS ctr,
  SUM(media_cost) AS spend,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(media_cost), SUM(clicks)) AS cpc,
  SUM(convs) AS conversions,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(average_time_seconds IS NOT NULL, average_time_seconds * clicks, 0)), SUM(IF(average_time_seconds IS NOT NULL, clicks, 0))) AS avg_time_on_site_sec,
  SUM(video_completed) AS video_completed,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(video_completed), SUM(impressions)) AS vcr
FROM `stackadapt-reporting.stackadapt_hamptons.v_daily_all`
WHERE campaign_group_id = '@@GROUP@@' AND stat_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((campaign_id, stat_date), (stat_date))
ORDER BY campaign, day
campaigns:
SELECT campaign_id,
  TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(ANY_VALUE(campaign), r'([^|]+)$')) AS campaign_name,
  ANY_VALUE(campaign) AS campaign,
  ANY_VALUE(campaign_group) AS campaign_group,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT channel_type, ', ') AS channel,
  SUM(impressions) AS impressions,
  SUM(clicks) AS clicks,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(clicks), SUM(impressions)) AS ctr,
  SUM(media_cost) AS spend,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(media_cost), SUM(clicks)) AS cpc,
  SUM(convs) AS conversions,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(average_time_seconds IS NOT NULL, average_time_seconds * clicks, 0)), SUM(IF(average_time_seconds IS NOT NULL, clicks, 0))) AS avg_time_on_site_sec,
  SUM(video_completed) AS video_completed,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(video_completed), SUM(impressions)) AS vcr
FROM `stackadapt-reporting.stackadapt_hamptons.v_daily_all`
WHERE campaign_group_id = '@@GROUP@@'
GROUP BY campaign_id ORDER BY clicks DESC
trackers:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT * FROM `stackadapt-reporting.stackadapt_hamptons.v_conversion_trackers_daily`
  WHERE campaign_group_id = '@@GROUP@@'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id, email_dt, conversion_trackers ORDER BY loaded_at DESC) = 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(campaign_id, 'all') AS campaign, conversion_trackers AS tracker,
  SUM(conversions) AS conversions,
  SUM(click_conversions) AS click_conversions,
  SUM(impression_conversions) AS impression_conversions
FROM c GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((campaign_id, conversion_trackers), (conversion_trackers))
ORDER BY campaign, conversions DESC
demographics:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM `stackadapt-reporting.stackadapt_hamptons.v_demographics_daily`
  WHERE campaign_group_id = '@@GROUP@@'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id, email_dt, demographic_segment ORDER BY loaded_at DESC) = 1
), t AS (
  SELECT campaign_id, stat_date, impressions AS day_impressions, media_cost AS day_spend
  FROM `stackadapt-reporting.stackadapt_hamptons.v_daily_all` WHERE campaign_group_id = '@@GROUP@@'
), j AS (
  -- StackAdapt reports a segment's impressions and spend as a share of the whole report (all segment types together); normalise per type, then convert to counts
  SELECT d.campaign_id, d.demographic_segment, d.clicks, d.conversions, d.average_time_seconds, d.video_completed,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(d.video_completed, d.video_completion_rate / 100) AS video_base,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(d.impressions, SUM(d.impressions) OVER w) * t.day_impressions AS impressions,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(d.spend, SUM(d.spend) OVER w) * t.day_spend AS spend
  FROM d LEFT JOIN t ON t.campaign_id = d.campaign_id AND t.stat_date = DATE_SUB(d.email_dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY d.campaign_id, d.email_dt, REGEXP_EXTRACT(d.demographic_segment, r'>\s*([^>]+?)\s*>\s*[^>]+$'))
)
SELECT COALESCE(campaign_id, 'all') AS campaign, demographic_segment AS segment,
  TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(demographic_segment, r'>\s*([^>]+?)\s*>\s*[^>]+$')) AS segment_type,
  TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(demographic_segment, r'([^>]+)$')) AS segment_name,
  ROUND(SUM(impressions)) AS impressions,
  SUM(clicks) AS clicks,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(clicks), SUM(impressions)) AS ctr,
  ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS spend,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(spend), SUM(clicks)) AS cpc,
  SUM(conversions) AS conversions,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(average_time_seconds IS NOT NULL, average_time_seconds * clicks, 0)), SUM(IF(average_time_seconds IS NOT NULL, clicks, 0))) AS avg_time_on_site_sec,
  SUM(video_completed) AS video_completed,
  -- completion rate from the report's own rate (its impressions are estimated, so not used here)
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(video_completed), SUM(video_base)) AS vcr
FROM j GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((campaign_id, demographic_segment), (demographic_segment))
ORDER BY campaign, segment_type, segment_name
audiences:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM `stackadapt-reporting.stackadapt_hamptons.v_audiences_daily`
  WHERE campaign_group_id = '@@GROUP@@'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id, email_dt, audience_segment ORDER BY loaded_at DESC) = 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(campaign_id, 'all') AS campaign, audience_segment AS segment,
  ANY_VALUE(audience_type) AS audience_type,
  TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(audience_segment, r'([^>]+)$')) AS segment_name,
  IF(STRPOS(audience_segment, '>') > 0, TRIM(SPLIT(audience_segment, '>')[OFFSET(0)]), ANY_VALUE(audience_type)) AS provider,
  SUM(impressions) AS impressions,
  SUM(clicks) AS clicks,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(clicks), SUM(impressions)) AS ctr,
  SUM(spend) AS spend,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(spend), SUM(clicks)) AS cpc,
  SUM(conversions) AS conversions,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(average_time_seconds IS NOT NULL, average_time_seconds * clicks, 0)), SUM(IF(average_time_seconds IS NOT NULL, clicks, 0))) AS avg_time_on_site_sec,
  SUM(video_completed) AS video_completed,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(video_completed), SUM(impressions)) AS vcr
FROM d GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((campaign_id, audience_segment), (audience_segment))
ORDER BY campaign, impressions DESC
domains:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM `stackadapt-reporting.stackadapt_hamptons.v_domains_daily`
  WHERE campaign_group_id = '@@GROUP@@'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id, email_dt, domain, app_title ORDER BY loaded_at DESC) = 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(campaign_id, 'all') AS campaign, domain,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(ANY_VALUE(app_title), ''), domain) AS site_or_app,
  IF(STARTS_WITH(domain, 'bundle/') OR LOGICAL_OR(IFNULL(app_title, '') != ''), 'App', 'Website') AS inventory,
  SUM(impressions) AS impressions,
  SUM(clicks) AS clicks,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(clicks), SUM(impressions)) AS ctr,
  SUM(spend) AS spend,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(spend), SUM(clicks)) AS cpc,
  SUM(conversions) AS conversions,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(average_time_seconds IS NOT NULL, average_time_seconds * clicks, 0)), SUM(IF(average_time_seconds IS NOT NULL, clicks, 0))) AS avg_time_on_site_sec,
  SUM(video_completed) AS video_completed,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(video_completed), SUM(impressions)) AS vcr
FROM d GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((campaign_id, domain), (domain))
ORDER BY campaign, impressions DESC

geo:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT *, LPAD(zip_code, 5, '0') AS zip5 FROM (
  SELECT * FROM `stackadapt-reporting.stackadapt_hamptons.v_geo_daily`
  WHERE campaign_group_id = '@@GROUP@@'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id, email_dt, region, city, zip_code ORDER BY loaded_at DESC) = 1
  ) WHERE zip_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(zip_code) != ''
), a AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(campaign_id, 'all') AS campaign, zip5 AS zip_code, ANY_VALUE(city) AS city, ANY_VALUE(region) AS region,
    SUM(impressions) AS impressions,
  SUM(clicks) AS clicks,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(clicks), SUM(impressions)) AS ctr,
  SUM(spend) AS spend,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(spend), SUM(clicks)) AS cpc,
  SUM(conversions) AS conversions,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(average_time_seconds IS NOT NULL, average_time_seconds * clicks, 0)), SUM(IF(average_time_seconds IS NOT NULL, clicks, 0))) AS avg_time_on_site_sec,
  SUM(video_completed) AS video_completed,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(video_completed), SUM(impressions)) AS vcr
  FROM g GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((campaign_id, zip5), (zip5))
)
SELECT a.*, z.internal_point_lat AS lat, z.internal_point_lon AS lon
FROM a LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z ON z.zip_code = a.zip_code
ORDER BY campaign, clicks DESC, impressions DESC
zip_shapes:
WITH clicked AS (
  SELECT LPAD(zip_code, 5, '0') AS zip_code FROM `stackadapt-reporting.stackadapt_hamptons.v_geo_daily` WHERE campaign_group_id = '@@GROUP@@'
  GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(clicks) + SUM(IFNULL(video_completed, 0)) > 0
)
SELECT z.zip_code, REPLACE(ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_SIMPLIFY(z.zip_code_geom, 80), 0.0005)), ' ', '') AS geometry
FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z JOIN clicked USING (zip_code)
counties:
WITH pts AS (
  SELECT z.internal_point_geom AS p
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
  WHERE z.zip_code IN (SELECT DISTINCT LPAD(zip_code, 5, '0') FROM `stackadapt-reporting.stackadapt_hamptons.v_geo_daily` WHERE campaign_group_id = '@@GROUP@@')
)
SELECT c.geo_id, ANY_VALUE(c.county_name) AS county_name,
  REPLACE(ANY_VALUE(ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_SIMPLIFY(c.county_geom, 1000), 0.002))), ' ', '') AS geometry
FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.counties` c
JOIN pts ON ST_DWITHIN(c.county_geom, pts.p, 30000)
WHERE c.state_fips_code IN ('36', '34', '09', '06', '42', '25', '44')
GROUP BY c.geo_id
basemap:
WITH reached AS (
  SELECT z.internal_point_lon AS lon, z.internal_point_lat AS lat
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
  WHERE z.zip_code IN (SELECT DISTINCT LPAD(zip_code, 5, '0') FROM `stackadapt-reporting.stackadapt_hamptons.v_geo_daily` WHERE campaign_group_id = '@@GROUP@@')
), b AS (
  SELECT IF(lon > -100, 'east', 'west') AS region,
    ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(FORMAT('POLYGON((%f %f, %f %f, %f %f, %f %f, %f %f))',
      MIN(lon) - 0.35, MIN(lat) - 0.25, MAX(lon) + 0.35, MIN(lat) - 0.25, MAX(lon) + 0.35, MAX(lat) + 0.25, MIN(lon) - 0.35, MAX(lat) + 0.25, MIN(lon) - 0.35, MIN(lat) - 0.25)) AS box
  FROM reached GROUP BY 1
), u AS (
  SELECT b.region, ST_UNION_AGG(ST_SIMPLIFY(z.zip_code_geom, 60)) AS g
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z JOIN b ON ST_INTERSECTS(z.zip_code_geom, b.box)
  GROUP BY b.region
)
SELECT u.region,
  REPLACE(ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_SNAPTOGRID(ST_SIMPLIFY(ST_INTERSECTION(ST_BUFFER(ST_BUFFER(u.g, 250), -250), b.box), 150), 0.0005)), ' ', '') AS geometry
FROM u JOIN b USING (region)
